info.en: Ability to open some doors and chests. A door (or a chest) needs two turns of picking to be open
info.ro: Capacitatea sa deschida niste usi si cufere. O usa (sau un cufar) necesita doua runde de spargere pentru a se deschide

info.en: When attacking, this character will deal damage twice
info.ro: Cand ataca, acest caracter va lovi dublu

info.en: If an ally is adjacent to the unit, during combat defense and resistance are increased by 1
info.ro: Daca un aliat este adiacent acestei unitati, apararea si rezistenta sunt marite cu 1 în timpul luptei.

info.en: Probability to stun an enemy when using a weapon able to do it is increased by 5%
info.ro: Probabilitatea de a bloca un inamic in timpul utilizarii armei creste cu 5%
